2607.10231.title: PhenoEmbed: Self-Supervised Multispectral UAV Time-Series Embeddings for Individual Tree Crown Phenology
2607.10231.paper_summary: Tree crowns are a challenging target for resilient AI because they are not static objects: their spectral response, internal texture, translucency, and apparent boundaries change substantially across the growing season. We develop PhenoEmbed, a self-supervised crown-centric temporal embedding model trained with contrastive and masked reconstruction objectives on HeideBench, an 18-date UAV multispectral time-series benchmark for forest crown phenology in D{ö}lauer Heide. The model treats seasonal crown dynamics as phenological appearance change driven by leaf emergence, canopy closure, senescence, and leaf-off conditions. Segmented tree crown polygons are retained as object anchors to extract aligned crown-centered crops through time, allowing one 256-dimensional vector summarizing seasonal crown appearance to be learned per tree. On 5,885 crop-safe crowns, the exported embeddings show structured low-dimensional organization, with the first two principal components explaining 25.1\% of variance and nearest-neighbor retrieval producing a median top-1 cosine similarity of 0.946. Compared with handcrafted temporal features and a learned mean-pooling baseline, PhenoEmbed yields substantially more compact nearest-neighbor structure, while ablations show that the contrastive loss, masked reconstruction loss, and explicit seasonal time features each affect the structure of the learned embedding space. These results support PhenoEmbed as a reusable forest crown representation learner and motivate future downstream tests of whether such features improve tree-level models under seasonal change.
2607.10231.paper_summary_zh: 樹冠對於韌性人工智慧來說是一個具有挑戰性的目標，因為它們不是靜態物體：它們的光譜反應、內部紋理、半透明性和明顯邊界在生長季節中有著顯著的變化。<lb/>我們開發了 PhenoEmbed，一種以樹冠為中心的自我監督時間嵌入模型，該模型在 HeideBench 上進行訓練，該基準是針對 D{ö}lauer Heide 的森林樹冠表型學的 18 個日期無人機多光譜時間序列基準，使用對比和遮蔽重建目標。<lb/>該模型將季節性樹冠動態視為由葉片出現、樹冠閉合、衰老和落葉條件驅動的表型外觀變化。<lb/>分割的樹冠多邊形作為物體錨點被保留，以提取隨時間變化的對齊樹冠中心裁剪，從而允許每棵樹學習一個總結季節性樹冠外觀的 256 維向量。<lb/>在 5,885 個安全裁剪的樹冠上，導出的嵌入顯示出結構化的低維組織，前兩個主成分解釋了 25.1\% 的方差，最近鄰檢索產生的中位數 top-1 餘弦相似度為 0.946。<lb/>與手工製作的時間特徵和學習的均值池基準相比，PhenoEmbed 產生了更緊湊的最近鄰結構，而消融實驗顯示對比損失、遮蔽重建損失和顯式季節時間特徵各自影響學習的嵌入空間結構。<lb/>這些結果支持 PhenoEmbed 作為可重用的森林樹冠表示學習器，並激勵未來下游測試這些特徵是否能改善季節變化下的樹木級模型。
